optative third singular active of bhū

items.question: Under what condition does the annual worship become fruitful?
items.inference: The verse states that annual worship yields fruit only when performed as prescribed, not otherwise.
uncertainties: the exact ritual conditions making the worship fruitful are not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: His annual worship becomes fruitful; otherwise it does not.
